_comment: #015 loss: same MSE on (B, n_bins) as #014, with two patches. snr_weighting flipped to true (Min-SNR-γ at γ=5, Hang et al 2023; addresses the loss/per_t_q3 plateau noted on #014). stop_weight dropped 1.5 -> 1.0 (under MSE-on-scaled-one-hot the 1.5 multiplier biases unconditional output toward STOP — different sign than the softmax-CE convention it was copied from on #002). Everything else identical to #014.
